description: Terminal-Bench style service recovery: fix the drifted systemd unit (wrong interpreter path, no restart policy, no User/WorkingDirectory) and the broken env file so the gate's parser accepts the unit AND the service actually boots and answers /health.

criteria: The unit matches the spec (python3 interpreter, Restart=always, User=app, WorkingDirectory=/opt/app) and the env file points TOKEN_FILE at the real token file - proven by the gate actually booting the service with the fixed env and probing /health, not just by parsing.
